pdf_title: Sample ES RFI-001 RTU-2 Curb Adapter
project: Sample Elementary School HVAC Replacement, Sample ISD  |  Project 2026-0001
to: Alex Poe, Sample Engineering, Inc. (Engineer of Record)
subject: The new RTU-2 does not fit the existing curb. We need direction on the curb adapter before we set the unit.
references: Drawing M-101 (Roof Plan). Spec section 23 74 13 (Packaged Rooftop Units). Related: PCO-001.
background: We are replacing RTU-1 and RTU-2.
RTU-1 is set on a new curb adapter and is level.
The new RTU-2 has a different footprint than the old unit. The existing curb does not match the new unit's supply and return openings.
A photo of each unit is attached.
question: How do you want us to set RTU-2? Please pick one:
1.  Use a factory curb adapter that matches the old curb to the new unit.
2.  Remove the old curb and set a new full curb.
Please send a drawing or a written answer.
proposed_resolution: We recommend option 1. It keeps the roof opening as is.
The curb adapter is not in the contract documents. We will price it as a change order (PCO-001).
Please tell us which option to use so we can schedule the crane.
